options.content:
**Offentlig visning — efterspørgsel ved hylden**

Data opdateres automatisk hvert 30. sek. Spil med ≤ 5 scanninger overvejes til udskiftning.

panels.description: Klik på tallet for seneste scanninger

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at)

panels.title: Scanninger i perioden

panels.description: Klik på tallet for top 15 spil

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id)::bigint AS value FROM scans s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at)

panels.title: Spil med mindst 1 scan

panels.description: Klik på tallet for spil med lave scanninger

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT s.game_id) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric FROM games), 0), 1) AS value FROM scans s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at)

panels.title: Andel af kataloget i brug

panels.description: Klik på tallet for fuld liste (0–5 scanninger)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM games g LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.game_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS scans FROM scans s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at) GROUP BY s.game_id) cnt ON cnt.game_id = g.id WHERE COALESCE(cnt.scans, 0) <= 5

panels.title: Spil med lave scanninger (≤ 5)

panels.description: Klik på en søjle for at åbne spillets QR-side (ny fane)

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.name AS name, g.slug AS slug, COUNT(*)::bigint AS scans FROM scans s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at) GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.slug ORDER BY scans DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top 15 — højest efterspørgsel (køb/flere eksemplarer)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(scanned_at,'1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Klik på Slug for at åbne spillets QR-side

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.name AS "Spil", g.slug AS "Slug", COALESCE(g.year_published::text, '—') AS "År", COALESCE(cnt.scans, 0)::bigint AS "Scanninger" FROM games g LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.game_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS scans FROM scans s WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at) GROUP BY s.game_id) cnt ON cnt.game_id = g.id WHERE COALESCE(cnt.scans, 0) <= 5 ORDER BY COALESCE(cnt.scans, 0) ASC, g.name

panels.title: Spil med lave scanninger - Overvej udskiftning

panels.description: Klik på Slug for at åbne spillets QR-side

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.scanned_at AS "Tidspunkt", g.name AS "Spil", g.slug AS "Slug" FROM scans s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at) ORDER BY s.scanned_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Seneste 50 scanninger

panels.description: Antal scanninger fordelt på ugedag (dansk tid, mandag foerst)

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Copenhagen')::int AS dow FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at)) SELECT CASE dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Mandag' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tirsdag' WHEN 3 THEN 'Onsdag' WHEN 4 THEN 'Torsdag' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fredag' WHEN 6 THEN 'Loerdag' WHEN 7 THEN 'Soendag' END AS name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS scans FROM t GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Hvornår tages spil fra hylden — per ugedag

panels.description: Antal scanninger fordelt på tidspunkt (dansk tid)

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Copenhagen')::int AS h FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at)), b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN h BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN 1 WHEN h BETWEEN 14 AND 16 THEN 2 WHEN h BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN 3 WHEN h < 10 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS s, CASE WHEN h BETWEEN 10 AND 13 THEN '10-14 Formiddag' WHEN h BETWEEN 14 AND 16 THEN '14-17 Eftermiddag' WHEN h BETWEEN 17 AND 21 THEN '17-22 Aften' WHEN h < 10 THEN 'Foer aabning' ELSE 'Sent / andet' END AS name FROM t) SELECT name, COUNT(*)::bigint AS scans FROM b GROUP BY s, name ORDER BY s

panels.title: Hvornår tages spil fra hylden — per tid på dagen

options.content:
**Ydeevne — hvad måles?**
- **Server ms:** tid fra scan-request til HTML er klar (inkl. database).
- **DB ms:** tid til at gemme scan i Postgres.
- **Klient ms:** tid i gæstens browser (QR → færdig tak-side). Sendes automatisk efter load.
- **Grafana:** data er i Postgres med det samme; dashboard opdateres ca. hvert 30. sek.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(server_duration_ms))::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND server_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(db_duration_ms))::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND db_duration_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT ROUND(AVG(client_load_ms))::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND client_load_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY server_duration_ms)::bigint AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND server_duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(scanned_at,'1d'), ROUND(AVG(server_duration_ms))::bigint AS "Server ms", ROUND(AVG(client_load_ms))::bigint AS "Klient ms" FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(scanned_at) AND server_duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.scanned_at AS "Tidspunkt", g.name AS "Spil", s.server_duration_ms AS "Server ms", s.db_duration_ms AS "DB ms", s.client_load_ms AS "Klient ms" FROM scans s JOIN games g ON g.id = s.game_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.scanned_at) ORDER BY s.scanned_at DESC LIMIT 30
